source_text: Senuit Iesus; vocavit Israel: Ego senui. Vidistis quae fecerit Dominus. Fortes estote et custodite legem.
pass_a_gloss: Grew-old Jesus; he-called Israel: I grew-old. You-have-seen what has-done Lord. Strong be and keep law.
pass_b_english: [[Jesus grew old; he called Israel: I am old >> Bible:Joshua 23:1-2]]. You have seen what the Lord has done. Be strong and keep the law.
